content: MCP architecture (official docs, spec 2026-07-28): host creates one client per server; local servers via stdio typically serve a single MCP client; Streamable HTTP for remote/multi-client. Data layer: JSON-RPC 2.0, now stateless per-request with _meta; server/discover replaces initialize handshake; primitives: tools (model-controlled actions), resources, prompts; sampling and logging deprecated in 2026-07-28; elicitation exists (InputRequiredResult). stdio = newline-delimited JSON-RPC over subprocess streams.
